# Weather Proof Roofing and Building Services

> Roofing and building contractor covering Cheshire, North Wales, Merseyside and Greater Manchester. New roofs and
> re-roofing, roof repairs, chimney repairs, ridge and verge work, guttering,
> fascias and soffits, and general building work.

Contact: 07718 155997 (phone and WhatsApp)
Website: https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/

## Services

- [New Roofs and Re-Roofing](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/new-roofs-and-re-roofing/): Full strip and re-cover in slate or tile, with new felt and battens.
- [Roof Repairs and Leak Fixing](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roof-repairs/): Slipped tiles, leaks, valleys and flashings put right before they get worse.
- [Chimney Repairs and Repointing](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/chimney-repairs/): Repointing, re-flaunching, new pots and cowls, or a full rebuild.
- [Ridge Tiles and Verge Repairs](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/ridge-and-verge-work/): Ridge tiles re-bedded or dry fixed, and verges made secure against the wind.
- [Guttering, Fascias and Soffits](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/guttering-fascias-and-soffits/): Gutters, downpipes, fascias and soffits replaced or cleared out.
- [Building Work and Brickwork](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/building-work/): Brickwork, pointing and general building work by the same team.

## Areas covered

- [Roofers in Chester](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-chester/): Chester, Cheshire. Also covers Hoole, Handbridge, Upton, Saltney, Christleton, Vicars Cross.
- [Roofers in Wrexham](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-wrexham/): Wrexham, Wrexham County Borough. Also covers Rhosddu, Gwersyllt, Borras, Rhostyllen, Coedpoeth, Marchwiel.
- [Roofers in Queensferry](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-queensferry/): Queensferry, Flintshire. Also covers Sandycroft, Garden City, Shotton, Connahs Quay, Mancot, Hawarden.
- [Roofers in Flint](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-flint/): Flint, Flintshire. Also covers Bagillt, Oakenholt, Northop, Holywell, Greenfield, Pentre Halkyn.
- [Roofers in Warrington](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-warrington/): Warrington, Cheshire. Also covers Great Sankey, Culcheth, Stockton Heath, Penketh, Birchwood, Grappenhall.
- [Roofers in Ellesmere Port](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-ellesmere-port/): Ellesmere Port, Cheshire. Also covers Great Sutton, Little Sutton, Whitby, Hooton, Overpool, Childer Thornton.
- [Roofers in The Wirral](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-the-wirral/): The Wirral, Merseyside. Also covers Birkenhead, Wallasey, Heswall, West Kirby, Bebington, Hoylake.
- [Roofers in Manchester](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-manchester/): Manchester, Greater Manchester. Also covers Didsbury, Chorlton, Withington, Prestwich, Levenshulme, Sale.
- [Roofers in Stockport](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-stockport/): Stockport, Greater Manchester. Also covers Marple, Romiley, Cheadle, Bramhall, Hazel Grove, Reddish.
- [Roofers in St Helens](https://innov8-workflows.github.io/Weather-Proof-Roofing-Building-Services/roofers-in-st-helens/): St Helens, Merseyside. Also covers Rainhill, Newton-le-Willows, Haydock, Eccleston, Billinge, Rainford.
